full_judgment: 2. The facts, as stated in the petition, in short, are that the petitioner is a service holder. He does not own and possess more than two acres of cultivable land. The Respondent No. 3 who claims to have owned and possessed less than two acres of land sold 58-3/4 acres of land appertaining to SA and RS Dag Nos. 320/77 and 36/47 of SA and RS Khatian Nos. 62/230 and 139/229 of Mouza Bankaiz, Upazila Lohajang, District Munshiganj to the petitioner for a consideration of Taka 35,000.00 by registered sale deed No. 21369 dated 1-10-85. The petitioner claims that the price of the land was the highest in the market when the said land was sold The respondent No. 3 as plaintiff filed an application in prescribed form on 25-11-89 under section 7 of the Bangladesh Rin Salishi Ain 1989 before the Chairman, Lohajang Upazila Rin Salishi Board for cancelling the sale deed dated 1-10-85 and directing the petitioner to return the land to the respondent No. 3. The respondent No. 1, the said board, issued notice upon the petitioner to appear before the board. The petitioner appeared and submitted that the Board had no jurisdiction to entertain the application since the value of the land in respect of which the case was filed was Taka 35,000.00 while the pecuniary jurisdiction of the Board is Taka 30,000.00 only under the Bangladesh Rin Salishi Ain, 1989.
